newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia pipeline attacks spill 8,000 bbls crude.
newsitem.headline: Colombia pipeline attacks spill 8,000 bbls crude.

text.p: Colombia's state-run oil company Ecopetrol said almost 8,000 barrels of crude oil were spilled in the two most recent rebel attacks on one of the country's main pipelines.

A spokesman said 1,115 barrels were spilled in the first dynamite attack on July 6 near the town of Arauquita in northeast Arauca province, 43 miles (69 km) from the Cano Limon oil field, operated by U.S. multinational Occidental Petroleum Corp.
The second blast, on July 10, about 30 miles (47 km) from Cano Limon, resulted in the spillage of 6,753 barrels, the spokesman said.
The pipeline, which has a capacity to pump about 250,000 barrels a day, was repaired and came back into service last Friday.
Ecopetrol said that exports from the Caribbean coast lifting terminal at Covenas were still paralyzed until a new export schedule was drawn up.
